answer: Each agent files one unique relic to join. Filing locks a 70-credit bond and records the relic's kernel hash; a repeat is rejected. A river of filings flows past auditors, who check one in twenty and slash fakes. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 relics: 70,000 locked plus 25,000 fees, above a 40,000 pool. Rented relics fail: the kernel is re-checked each epoch; one relic lent twice flags both. Honest agents file once, pay 25, keep the bond.
